reviews.text: Staffs were always friendly and very accommodating.

Couldn't ask for a better local shop for everything pup-related we could ever need. Big shout-out to Chang for taking the time to talk through dog food options with us and being incredibly polite and friendly along the way!
Fantastic, affordable grooming service. My dog is shy, and it is often quite difficult to trim her nails. They did it with no problem! Highly recommend.

Very nice staff. Clean venue. I asked grooming (premium bath + teeth + nails + gnal) and she finished quickly, and nicely. I took off one star due to the price. The price is a bit higher (about $85 for all) than other places (I used to pay about $65 for similar services) but this is the closest location from my new home, and I guess it is what it is.
My visit yesterday to Doggie Style South went well for me and Sadie, my greyhound.  KellyAnne did a great job and offered suggestions for future visits.  na
Walleed is the best! He listens and my dogs’ cuts always turn out perfect!

Came into the store tonight with my dog, the interaction felt stale, and did not even say hi to my dog, nor offer a treat. How do you work at a pet store, and not want to say hi to every pet that walks into the store? This location has constant turnover, and it’s nothing like the staff from last Summer. We prefer the Rittenhouse location now, we won’t be coming to the South Street store anymore.

Sad

I truly cannot express how dishonest, sub-par, and outright unacceptable the grooming service is at this location, and the customer service of the management. If you want a grooming service that will listen to simple instructions, DO NOT come here.

About a week ago, my dog, Bonci, went in for a groom. I gave the groomer ONE, very simple instruction that many dog parents will understand -- "please do not cut his intimate parts too short, as it will be very itchy and uncomfortable." I gave both an instruction, and a reason. As dog owners know, a short trim or a shave can cause razor burn, which in turn leads to hot spots and injury.

Regardless of whether a grooming service should know this, my ask was simple -- just LISTEN TO MY ONE INSTRUCTION. It is a service after all, is it not?

I paid before the groomer came out with my dog (and tipped, as usual). To my surprise, her first comment was an apology -- she had failed to do the ONE thing I asked her to do. Before we even left the establishment, my dog was whining, scooting on the floor, and signaling clear discomfort in his intimate areas. He had difficulty walking home, as he sat down every few steps to soothe the pain that the movement of his legs caused the area.

Hoping that he would not be in too much pain, I took my dog home. However, later that day, it was clear that he was in distress. He refused to go on walks, stand for long periods of time, and continually whined and cried in pain. So, I did what every dog parent would do. I called the vet.

The vet advised us to apply hydrocortisone cream twice a day, and to put a cone on him to prevent him from licking his growing injury, which became red, raw, and threatened infection. So, we purchased a cone and clothes to prevent him from licking.

I reached out to this store's location to receive a refund for the service. After all, they failed to do the ONE thing I asked. If I had gotten a haircut, for example, and they left me in pain and crying, a refund would really be the least they could do.

How wrong I was! Instead, I responded to a dozen emails, received phone calls where I repeated the same information over and over again, and sent pictures of Bonci's injury and the vet's advice.

This morning, I received an appalling email. Despite the groomer's immediate apology, her promise to put a note in the file so that she does not violate my instructions again, and all the evidence I had provided, Howard, the CEO, refused to give me a refund. His reason? That the groomer had removed matting on my dog "for free."

The only problems? (1) I was never charged for a mat removal; (2) I was never told about matting (which is their policy); (3) The area affected had such short hair, that matting was near impossible; (4) my dog had been regularly brushed and detangled, including on the morning of his groom. Oh, and the main reason -- the groomer TOLD ME that she forgot to follow the instructions, which caused the EXACT EFFECT I knew it would!

I have never experienced something like this in my entire life of dog ownership. A business like this should have a warning on the door.

I had my micro-Goldendoodle groomed here today. She needed a cut, bath, teeth brushed, and nail trim.  I was quite frustrated because her grooming took FOUR HOURS. That is a rediculous amount of time for a 12 pound little dog to be shaved and groomed.  Looking at my dog now, I am disappointed that her cut is quite uneven, and I will be trimming the uneven patches of her fur that were left behind.  Not a great experience.
Great staff who genuinely care about our furry friends and exceptional customer service. You can also volunteer to walk and spend time their lovely rescue pups (fill in a form & leave your ID)

I rarely leave reviews, but Chang was so good at their job today that I felt ethically compromised keeping it to myself. They have an encyclopedic knowledge of the store and guided me right to what I needed without the usual retail fluff. Exceptional service.
Just visited doggie style pets south and had an amazing visit! Chang was so helpful while we were looking for products to help our dog’s sensitive paws in the summer heat. Great service!!
Great store with great service. Chang was very helpful in assisting us find what we were looking for!
Really friendly staff, always A+ service. We love our baths at Doggie Style! Thank you for the treats, Chang! -Ridley and his mom
Love this store! Chang was extremely helpful and informative about toppers. I’m always comforted knowing there’s a store associate willing to help and answer questions!

My service animal has long hair, and goes with me everywhere. He gets dirty pretty fast.

The groomers at the South St have been nothing short of fantastic every time. They're gentle with him as well, they're the only groomers that he doesn't try to avoid when we walk past

I had a great experience with Doggie Style Pets South.

I originally called the Spring Garden location near Rodin Place, but they didn’t have any appointments available. The person who helped me on the phone was very kind and took the time to find me an appointment at the South Street location, which I really appreciated.

A few days before the appointment, I received a call asking if my dog Aldo had been seen at another location before. Since I usually take him to the Spring Garden location, there was a small issue with the records, but they were able to resolve it. That was the only minor hiccup.

The grooming appointment itself went very well. They did a fantastic job with Aldo. Normally, when I take him to other places, he comes home acting a little off, but this time he was completely normal and comfortable, which says a lot.

Overall, I’m very happy with the service and the care they gave my dog. I would definitely recommend them.

⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️½ (4.5/5)
